evidence.quote: The eighteen-month retention for Quillmoor field recordings, set on the 1 October planning call, is replaced by twelve months.

observations.why: Establishes a concrete administrative change in policy for specific field recordings in the immediate present as an enacted fact.

evidence.quote: The consent renewal letters sent in September came back from fewer than half of the participants

observations.why: Focuses on specific historical events from September grounding the factual rationale for the retention rule.

evidence.quote: Transcripts are still kept permanently; only the recordings change.

observations.why: States general ongoing policy rules regarding broad categories of material (transcripts vs recordings).
